links.outcome: Expert urologist rating of GPT-generated MDT report accuracy, completeness, clarity
links.effect: Final reports rated accurate in 90%, fairly accurate 8%, inaccurate 2%; completeness high in 95%; clarity high in 95%.
links.quote: After resolution of discordant ratings, the GPT-generated final reports were rated as accurate in 90% of cases, fairly accurate in 8%, and inaccurate in 2%.

links.outcome: Agreement of GPT recommendations with urologists, oncologists, radiation oncologists, and final MDT decision
links.quote: Exact agreement between UroMDT Advisor and urologists, oncologists, radiation oncologists, and final MDT decisions was 61.7%, 66.7%, 63.3%, and 66.7%, respectively; the corresponding unweighted Cohen's kappa values were 0.401, 0.489, 0.441, and 0.482.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, accuracy, and concordance of an LLM-based tool (UroMDT Advisor) for assisting multidisciplinary cancer teams using retrospective cases, but does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
